newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP close to selling Foster's stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: BHP close to selling Foster's stake - paper.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd is close to finalising a A$1.8 billion exit from its 36 percent stake in Foster's Brewing Group Ltd, the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday.
The newspaper said there was speculation that the sell-down would be announced this week, depending on market conditions.

"Stockbrokers Merrill Lynch are believed to be frontrunners for the role of selling the bulk of the Foster's shares to institutions," the newspaper said. "Foster's is expected to buy back 10 percent of its own shares as part of the deal," it said.
